recent_news.headline: Grease Happens: Why Smart Facilities Stay Ahead of the Mess
recent_news.summary: Editorial piece discussing grease trap maintenance for retail food operations, explaining how grocery stores, convenience stores and food courts manage FOG waste to protect operations and the public sewer system.

recent_news.headline: Beyond Oil USA and Eazy Grease Partner to Redefine Sustainable Frying Oil Management
recent_news.summary: Beyond Oil USA and Eazy Grease announced a strategic partnership combining oil purification technology that extends frying oil life with used cooking oil recycling services. The collaboration creates an end-to-end solution enabling restaurants to reduce oil consumption while ensuring used oil is recycled into renewable fuels, establishing a circular economy model for food service operations.

backfill_news.summary: Darling Ingredients announced it will host a conference call on October 29, 2026 at 9:00 AM ET to discuss Q3 2026 financial results. The company will release earnings earlier that day.
